text:
VELDMOOR BAY — Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial to victory in the Pallister Cup final race on 14 September 2023, people familiar with the matter said.

Seren Aduial completed the 212-nautical-mile course in 31 hours and 47 minutes, placing first among 18 entries.

Tobias Wrenfield, Chief Race Officer of the Pallister Cup Committee, confirmed Corrigan as skipper at the post-race briefing, the sources said.

The account rests on the official Pallister Cup Crew Declaration Form, filed with the Veldmoor Sailing Authority on 11 September 2023, three days before the race. The document lists Corrigan as the yacht's captain.

The race was held off the coast of Veldmoor Bay.

Neither the committee nor the sailing authority has issued a further statement on the result.
